name: Sign
overview: The Bible presents signs as divinely given miracles that confirm faith and authenticate God's promises. Figures such as Abraham, Moses, Gideon, and Jeroboam sought and received signs to validate God's word and reassure their trust, as seen when Abraham questions how he will inherit the promise, Moses doubts that others will believe his calling, and Gideon requests confirmation of God's presence. Signs also serve as tokens of coming events, exemplified by the prophet's sign of the altar at Bethel, where God's power was displayed through a miraculous act against King Jeroboam. These instances reveal that signs function as tangible evidence from God to strengthen belief and reveal His sovereign plans.
